title: Final Energy Corrections
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify and express the first order energy corrections E_{+} and E_{-} as (2 ± ε) ℏω.

title: Final Wavefunction Corrections
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the first order wavefunction corrections |±⟩ in terms of |±⟩^{(0)} and ε.

title: Second Order Energy Correction
description: Essential Criteria: The student must calculate and express the second order energy correction E^{(2)} as -2 ε² ℏω.

title: Matrix Elements Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly compute the matrix elements M_{ij} = ⟨i|H'|j⟩ for the relevant states.

title: Perturbation Theory Application
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate a clear understanding of how perturbation theory applies to the given Hamiltonian.

title: Use of Parity
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss the role of parity in selecting the relevant states for perturbation corrections.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the expressions for energy corrections and wavefunction corrections.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all terms are consistent in units, particularly when defining ε.
